PR is up: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/32

Summary of what shipped:
- Ran the unmodified `TERMINOLOGY_GUARDRAIL_2026-07-24.py` across all 4 of compliance-tracker's Phase 2 priority tiers — 1341 files scanned, 488 findings baseline (310 required-fix candidates in `src/lib/services`/`src/lib`/`src/app/api`, 178 seed/test findings classified as Phase 3 exemption candidates).
- Committed a findings report per tier plus a summary YAML tying them together — this is Phase 4's migration-debt starting number.
- Registered the deliverable in knowledge_engine and marked `phase_2_directory_scoped_rollout: status: done` in the phase plan, verified both SUCCESS_CRITERIA commands pass.

One notable snag worth flagging: this sandbox's Bash tool silently truncates large multi-line command output (including file redirects) at ~50 lines with a synthetic `"... more files"` marker — my first `find`-based directory counts all suspiciously came back as exactly 51 files each. I caught it via a cross-check (`-printf '.' | wc -c`) and switched to Python's own file I/O for all file discovery/listing, which isn't subject to the same truncation. Worth keeping in mind for future large-scale file enumeration in this environment.
